request.style: English, male choir, piano, strings, harp, organ, deep and solemn, 70 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Not everyone who speaks my name
Will enter in the gate of grace
But only those who do my will
Find a safe and steady place

[Verse]
A wise man built his house on rock
He heard the words and acted true
He did not let the voice go by
He made the solid foundation due

[Chorus]
When rain came down and rivers rose
And winds beat hard against the wall
The house stood firm and did not fall
Because its base was on the rock

[Verse]
A foolish man built house on sand
He heard the words but did not act
He let the truth go out of sight
And built his life on shifting track

[Chorus]
When rain came down and rivers rose
And winds beat hard against the wall
The house stood firm and did not fall
Because its base was on the rock

[Bridge]
The storm came with a heavy blow
The foolish house collapsed and broke
It fell with a great and loud crash
Upon the sandy, shifting stone

[Chorus]
When rain came down and rivers rose
And winds beat hard against the wall
The house stood firm and did not fall
Because its base was on the rock

[Outro]
Hear the words and act on them
Build your life on the rock
